data.assumption: I interpreted “share of authorised payments in the UK were captured last month” as the count of captured payment attempts divided by the count of authorised/authorized or captured payment attempts for UK showrooms in August 2026.
data.sql:
SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN LOWER(pa.status) = 'captured' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS DECIMAL) / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN LOWER(pa.status) IN ('authorised', 'authorized', 'captured') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS value
FROM payment_attempts pa
JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = pa.order_id
JOIN showrooms s ON s.showroom_id = o.showroom_id
LEFT JOIN countries c ON c.country_code = s.country_code
WHERE pa.is_test = FALSE
  AND o.is_test = FALSE
  AND pa.business_date >= DATE '2026-08-01'
  AND pa.business_date < DATE '2026-09-01'
  AND (s.country_code = 'GB' OR LOWER(c.name) IN ('united kingdom', 'uk'))
  AND LOWER(pa.status) IN ('authorised', 'authorized', 'captured')
